lines.text: Inside the robot, a controller sends commands on a steady beat. Waiting for AI can make it miss the next one.
lines.source: scripts/narration.json determinism[1,3]; lab-deadline-model.js blocking controller jobs. The visible beat is slowed for explanation.

lines.text: Three answers. Two arrive quickly. One takes longer. The machine cannot know which answer will hold it up.
lines.source: scripts/narration.json determinism[1,2]; lab-deadline-model.js synthetic latency. Three chosen examples, not a measured distribution or probability.

lines.text: So run AI beside the controller. Every beat, take the latest finished answer. Never wait for the next one.

lines.text: Problem solved? Watch the box move. The latest answer still says the path is clear. It describes an older world.
